scope: Cross-check the DWG/DXF 3D route from parsed entity through modeler carrier and writer output to a downstream ACIS-capable kernel/consumer; refine implementation-readiness gates only where evidence changes them.

method.kind: Current project-authored documentation, release notes, and issue reports
limitations: LibreDWG and ACadSharp issue observations are reports, not independently reproduced results.
Mutable documentation and repository branches are not version-pinned runtime evidence.
No support claim or external-only J disposition may be promoted from this review.

evidence.reportedObservation: Issue #1411, opened 2026-09-02, pins the reporter's build to LibreDWG 0.14.8593. It reports a generated AC1032 DXF REGION with 5,489 SAB bytes surviving DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF as an entity while AcDs/ACDSDATA bytes and records are lost; it also describes an unattached real R2018 file observation.
evidence.planningUse: Add explicit carrier-presence checks beside entity counts; do not call this a confirmed libdxfrw defect or general LibreDWG result.

evidence.route: ACadSharp DXF/DWG 3D-solid reader and DXF writer
evidence.reportedObservation: Release notes list ACIS payload reading for 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY in DXF and DWG, AcDs payload offset reading, and Prototype1b parsing. Open issue #1195 separately reports DWG input solids omitted by its DXF writer; the issue links writer work that was still open in the inspected state.
evidence.planningUse: Require direction-specific and per-handle writer closure evidence; do not infer writer support from reader support or release headlines.

evidence.reportedObservation: Project documentation says creation of required ACIS data must be done by an external library.
evidence.planningUse: Keep ezdxf as optional carrier/control author or bounded projection tool, not independent ACIS-kernel proof.

evidence.reportedObservation: Official OCCT-Components preview describes ACIS SAT/SAB import-export among commercial extensions and directs users to the components store for full components.
evidence.planningUse: Do not assume base open-source OCCT or a standard FreeCAD build has an ACIS reader; keep a licensed kernel route optional and separately approved.

evidence.reportedObservation: The project documentation distinguishes built-in C++ and legacy Python DXF importers and describes ACIS-solid limitations; documentation can lag code and backend selection.
evidence.planningUse: Any future consumer result must name exact FreeCAD release, importer backend, runtime, and shape/projection outcome.

evidence.reportedObservation: ODA documents a tool that loads matching DWG/DXF files and saves them to a requested output version/type, with optional audit/repair.
evidence.planningUse: A successful conversion is a translator result only; require independent payload and geometry checks before semantic claims.

requiredPerHandleObservations: inline SAT/SAB or AcDs/ACDSDATA carrier presence, length, and hash
exact destination output presence and graph closure
named consumer shape or derived projection disposition
planDelta.failurePolicy: Unsupported writer output with missing modeler bytes/links must fail transactionally; an entity-only shell is explicitly incomplete, never semantic support.
planDelta.existingS2_2_5bLocalControls: The existing focused matrix already covers 254/255/256 and 509/510/511 character boundaries, whitespace and indivisible-token cuts, explicit/implicit chunk metadata, and preserved-destination/corrected-retry negatives. Do not duplicate these synthetic controls; the same-profile legacy Binary-DXF SAT positive remains an external acceptance gate because the recorded ODA screen rejects both libdxfrw binary subjects and the ezdxf binary baseline.
planDelta.validationCadence: Retain fast local generated tests per implementation slice. Run pinned peer and native/kernel comparison only at an existing composed milestone; unavailable optional tools leave that evidence lane open without blocking local implementation.
